notes: Coverage: I read all five diffs in full, plus the full deep ref (580 lines) and all three distillations (211, 214, 230 lines). The light ref changed only its derived-from-deep stamp and holds no [V] markers on the re-marked quotations. I checked 12 index rows (6 decision-making, 2 software-business, 4 stakeholder-engagement). There is no vflags file for this slug, so there were no flagged quotations to grade. Every [V] quotation in an added or changed line matches the converted source word for word, allowing only for curly quotes and line breaks (checked with /usr/bin/grep -F and passage reads). All [BT] re-marks are correct: Ries/Trout 10859, Levitt 10059, Kotler 37655, AMA 12003, Costco 37800, Avis slogan 10918. The deep ref's new content matches the source, including locators, and covers the source-only passages the audit asked to add: Ch 1.1 interested parties and internal marketing; Ch 1.3 Zappos; Ch 1.6 CRM two-way street; Ch 1.7 dos and don'ts; Ch 2.2 market development and Harley-Davidson; Ch 8.2 diversity and PepsiCo; Ch 8.3 Texican Whopper; Ch 8.4 acculturation; Ch 10.5 two-step diffusion; Ch 11.2 Yoshida and employee satisfaction; Ch 13.4 and 14.2 objective-and-task; Ch 14.6 ethics; Ch 15.3 follow-up; Ch 16.2 under-30 platforms; Ch 17.4 channel members; Ch 19.2 stakeholder approach. Deep marker counts are now [V] 124, [AP] 28, [BT] 30, [AR] 0, [AE] 0, which matches the stakeholder-engagement line-230 statement. The claims about other corpus sources check out against their deep refs: OB (Ch 3.5 job satisfaction and commitment, Ch 2.5 Argyris), Accounting Vol 2 (Ch 1.5 TOC), Jones (Ch 3.6 pricing and CLV, Ch 5.3.1 twelve models, Ch 5.4.4 cone), Introduction to Business (Ch 11.9 skimming and penetration), Business Ethics (Ch 3.2 Donaldson and Preston, Ch 10 AI), Principles of Management (Ch 5.6 stakeholder theory and eight questions), Scrum Guide (Sprint Review). The claim that this text is the corpus's only treatment of the Gap Model and RATER holds: no other deep ref carries them. Every removal is justified by the audit record or by the source (NPS, brand hierarchy and GDPR appear in neither the deep ref nor the source; ADAMS is a segmentation test, not a promotion mix). I found no broken sentences, orphaned items, wrong table column counts or leftover edit traces. Points I did not grade, all on lines the repair left alone or text the audit prescribed: (1) stakeholder-engagement lines 8 and 51 list 'investors, shareholders' as two groups where the source says 'investors (shareholders)'; (2) software-business line 205 marks the PDMA studies [BT], but deep 323 marks them [V]; (3) software-business lines 75 and 131 add, as the audit prescribed, that 'a business analysis that prices the build honestly surfaces that earlier'. That is the distillation's own inference: it attributes nothing to the source, but the source presents Maxwell House as a Stage-6 finding made after business analysis.
